download_models: download the bot adversarial dialogue multi-turn classifier models to a given datapath
run_download: run the download function to fetch v1 multi-turn models for bot adversarial dialogue
review_download: review the download function that fetches bot adversarial dialogue models using ParlAI download_models
summarize_download: summarize the download function which downloads WikiToxicComments and adversarial dialogue classifier models
test_download: test the download function by calling it with a custom datapath directory
